method: Read-only audit of actual fixed-policy simulation and elite-probe records. Measurement-only amendment compared with complete first baseline; all non-measurement fields must be identical for all150 runs. No gameplay is changed by this script.

baseFinisherConflict.C21: 12 + 6×5 marks + 2×7 bleed =56 base, up to64 with shared cap8 bonus
baseFinisherConflict.S16: 16 +4×8 sword intent =48 base, up to56 with cap8
baseFinisherConflict.F12: 18 +4×6 soul =42 base, up to50 with cap8

healthMeasurement.start: Observed health after the initial player-turn setup; subsequent combat damage/healing is included.
healthMeasurement.end: First battle-ended snapshot, frozen before card rewards, later camps and story healing; actual heals after victory marker are subtracted for combat-only health.
healthMeasurement.note: No maximum HP or net-loss clamp is used. Negative loss means genuine net healing during that encounter.
